CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rsc_validate_rejection_progress_0173(checked_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE fact public.material_request_rejection_progress%ROWTYPE; expected jsonb; total bigint; matches bigint;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO STRICT fact FROM public.material_request_rejection_progress WHERE id=checked_id;
    expected:=jsonb_build_object('id',fact.id::text,'return_id',fact.return_id::text,'request_id',fact.request_id::text,
        'actor_person_id',fact.actor_person_id::text,'actor_role_assignment_id',fact.actor_role_assignment_id::text,
        'action',fact.action,'request_version',fact.request_version,'authorization_version',fact.authorization_version,
        'registration_request_hash',fact.registration_request_hash,'idempotency_key_hash',fact.idempotency_key_hash,
        'request_hash',fact.request_hash,'evidence_sha256',fact.evidence_sha256);
    SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER(WHERE stream_key='material_request'
      AND action='material_request.rejection_return.'||fact.action
      AND actor_user_id=fact.actor_user_id AND request_id=fact.trace_request_id
      AND occurred_at=fact.recorded_at AND created_at=fact.recorded_at
      AND before_jsonb=jsonb_build_object('rejection_return',CASE WHEN fact.action='handover' THEN 'departed' ELSE 'registered' END)
      AND after_jsonb=expected) INTO total,matches FROM public.audit_events
      WHERE aggregate_type='material_request_rejection_progress' AND aggregate_id=fact.id::text;
    IF total<>1 OR matches<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '0173 exact progress audit required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END;
$function$

statements:
CREATE TABLE material_request_rejection_progress (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	return_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	request_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	request_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_person_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	actor_role_assignment_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	authorization_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	registration_request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	previous_event_id UUID, 
	previous_request_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	physical_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	carrier VARCHAR(100), 
	tracking_no VARCHAR(100), 
	reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	trace_request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_jsonb JSONB NOT NULL, 
	recorded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_rejection_progress_parent UNIQUE (id, return_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(previous_event_id, return_id) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_progress (id, return_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_rejection_progress_action UNIQUE (return_id, action), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_rejection_progress_trace UNIQUE (actor_user_id, trace_request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_progress_action CHECK (action IN ('cancel_registration','depart','handover')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_progress_version CHECK (request_version > 0 AND authorization_version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_progress_reason CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_progress_physical CHECK ((action='cancel_registration' AND physical_at IS NULL) OR (action IN ('depart','handover') AND physical_at IS NOT NULL AND physical_at<=recorded_at)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_progress_predecessor CHECK ((action='handover' AND previous_event_id IS NOT NULL AND previous_request_hash IS NOT NULL AND carrier IS NOT NULL AND tracking_no IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(carrier))>0 AND length(trim(tracking_no))>0) OR (action<>'handover' AND previous_event_id IS NULL AND previous_request_hash IS NULL AND carrier IS NULL AND tracking_no IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(return_id) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_returns (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(request_id) REFERENCES material_requests (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_person_id) REFERENCES people (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_role_assignment_id) REFERENCES role_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key_hash)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_rejection_progress_request ON material_request_rejection_progress (request_id, return_id)
REVOKE ALL ON public.material_request_rejection_progress FROM PUBLIC,star_oam_api
GRANT SELECT,INSERT ON public.material_request_rejection_progress TO star_oam_api
